messages:
ravi: FYI probing alert: prod-eu GPU autoscaler stalled during morning rollout, warm-pool not filling for ~18m. Nodes stuck in Pending with keystore errors.
infra-ci: alert: gpu.pool.warm_nodes(<target) in prod-eu at 2026-04-05T07:12Z
nisha: which firewall change ran this morning? we had a baseline tighten to egress for control-plane ranges.
dana: I rolled fw change fw_eu_baseline_v3 at 2026-04-05T07:00Z to stop noisy collector traffic. It narrowed allowed egress to mgmt subnets and removed broad NAT access.
mike: node init logs show: ```2026-04-05T07:09:31Z keystore-proxy: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: "KMSGrantNotAuthorized: caller not in grant principals"
trace: node-init -> keystore-proxy -> privatelink -> kms-eu```
ravi: so the keystore grant fetch is blocked by egress rules. That prevents nodes from completing bootstrap and joining the pool.
nisha: urgent options: 1) temporary fw allow for keystore privatelink CIDR 10.3.64.0/28 2) re-enable NAT egress for ephem tag 3) failover onboarding to usw2 (high cost).
dana: prefer (1) limited TTL and audit tag. (2) is broader and defeats the baseline. (3) is last resort.
security-bot: Exception policy: require owner, TTL <= 4h, justification note, audit log export attachment, and compliance notification.
mike: quick mitigation I can do: add allow for 10.3.64.0/28 -> port 443 for keystore-proxy service account, TTL 90m. then trigger warm-pool reconcile.
ravi: please add monitoring hook: keystore.decrypt_ok{region="eu"} and gpu.pool.warm_nodes.count. Halt any upstream rollout until decrypt_ok>=0.95 for 2m.
ops-bot: policy-exception: #3021 created by mike (ttl 90m, expires 2026-04-05T08:41Z).
nisha: I'll post the justification in the ticket: "keystore grant retrieval blocked by tighter egress rule; nodes failing bootstrap; temporary exception to restore warm pool while we plan permanent fix."
dana: done. rolling the exception now.
mike: rolled exception, warm-pool reconcile started. logs show decrypts succeeding on new nodes: ```keystore: decrypt ok key=arn:aws:kms:eu:...:key/abcd1234```
ravi: monitoring: decrypt_ok jumped to 0.98, warm_nodes hitting target. Good.
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS grant audit logs and KMS key ids to incident record. Also include the fw change id that triggered this.
nisha: noted. I'll run a quick cost calc for two options: increase NAT egress budget vs deploy per-service privatelink endpoints by region. ETA 1 day.
mike: rough numbers: extra natgw/egress ~ $250/mo for eu under steady state; per-service privatelink ~ $700/mo + 1-2 ops hours/month. Cross-region fallback cost during onboarding spike ~ $0.15/GB egress, expected $40-200 per big spike.
ravi: owners: postmortem = @ravi, runtime fix = @mike, security signoff = @dana. Add runbook update: https://runbooks.redwoodinfra/internal/keystore-perf-eu
infra-ci: rollback-schedule: exception auto-removes at 2026-04-05T08:41Z unless extended.
dana: After we stabilize let's add a firewall pipeline check that simulates keystore grant fetch (job in CI) and a canary that provisions 2 nodes and verifies keystore.decrypt_ok before scaling.
nisha: agreed. also let's add an automated audit entry whenever a keystore exception is applied (so compliance sees it in real time).
ravi: thanks team, monitoring on watch. Will collect KMS grant logs for the PM. :thumbsup:
